fullContentHtml:

Bank of Baroda Peon Final Merit List is out on 28th August 2026 on the official website. Earlier, BOB Peon Result 2026 was declared on 28th July 2026. The BOB Office Assistant mains result PDF is published on official website of Bank of Baroda, https://bankofbaroda.bank.in/. Candidates who appeared for the BOB Peon Main Examination held on 22 March 2026 can now download the Final Merit List PDF and check whether their Registration Number appears in the Selected List or Wait List. The result has been published in PDF format in category-wise and state-wise categories. Candidates with names in merit list will be called to attend further recruitment formalities as notified by the Bank.

Bank of Baorda Peon Final Merit List 2026 Out

Bank of Baroda has released BOB Peon Merit List 2026 on the official website on 28th August 2026. Candidates who qualified the mains exam can now downlaod the BOB Peon Final Merit List PDF and check their qualification status. The candidates whose names are mentioned in the PDF are appointed as Peon in the Bank of Baroda branches across India. Click on the link below to download the BOB Peon Final Result.

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026 Download Link

The Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) Mains Result 2026 PDF is available for download at the official website bankofbaroda.bank.in under the Careers section. The PDF also contains the registration numbers of candidates provisionally selected under the Selected Category List and the Wait List. Candidates need to download the result PDF and search for their Registration Number with the Ctrl + F option.

BOB Peon Mains Result 2026 Link – Click to Download

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026 Overview

The Bank of Baroda Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 has completed its Main Exam stage. All the participating states’ mains results have been released in the form of PDF. Some important highlights are given below.

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026 PDF

The Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result PDF has the registration numbers of candidates who have been shortlisted after the Main Examination. The bank has published the Selected List and the Wait List separately for each State and category. No individual scorecard / marks released with result.

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026 PDF – Click to Download

Bank of Baroda Peon Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

BOB Peon recruitment stages are almost done, with the release of the mains exam result. Candidates can check the important dates below.

Event Date
Preliminary Examination 22 & 23 February 2026
Preliminary Result 11 March 2026
Main Examination 22 March 2026
Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result Released
Final Merit List Released

How to Download Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026?

Candidates can access the BOB Peon Mains Result 2026 using the official website without entering any login details. Result is downloadable only in PDF. The steps include:

  1. Visit official website bankofbaroda.bank.in
  2. Click on the Careers section
  3. Open Current Opportunities
  4. Click on Office Assistant (Peon) Mains Result 2026
  5. Download Result PDF
  6. Press Ctrl + F
  7. Enter your Registration Number
  8. Save PDF for future reference

Details Mentioned in Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026

The important information needed by shortlisted candidates is included in the BOB Office Assistant Result PDF. Only qualifying details are provided because the results were released in merit list style. The PDF includes:

  • Registration Number
  • State Name
  • Category
  • Selected List
  • Wait List
  • Recruitment Name

BOB Peon Final Merit List 2026

Based on candidates’ performance in the BOB Peon Main Examination, the Bank of Baroda Final Merit List 2026 was created. Two merit lists are included in the mains result:

  • Selected Category List
  • Wait List

While applicants on the Wait List might be taken into consideration if positions become available during the hiring process, candidates whose registration numbers appear in the Selected List have been temporarily shortlisted.

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Bank of Baroda Mains Result 2026 out?

Ans: Yes! The Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) Mains Result 2026 has been released on the official website.

Q2. Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Result PDF Download How?

Ans: The candidates can download the BOB Peon Mains result PDF from the Careers section of bankofbaroda.bank.in.

Q3. When was Bank of Baroda Peon Main Exam?

Ans: The BOB Peon Main Examination was conducted on 22 March 2026.

Q4. When was the BOB Office Assistant Preliminary Examination conducted?

Ans: The BOB Peon Preliminary Examination was held on 22 and 23 February 2026.

Q5. When was the Bank of Baroda Peon Prelims Result declared?

Ans: The Preliminary Result was announced on 11 March 2026.

Q6. Does the BOB Peon Mains result contain marks?

Ans: No! The Bank has released only the Selected List and Wait List containing registration numbers.
